message: I am thinking...: Architecture options: DOM line spans would make native selection difficult and custom multi-caret rendering complex; canvas gives complete ownership and predictable geometry, with a focusable scroll container and hidden clipboard event interception (without textarea/input as editing surface). Use canvas in a scrollable viewport with a spacer, render only visible lines, custom hit-testing, selection/carets, mouse drag + autoscroll, word/line click selection. Document model as one string with normalized caret ranges and offset/line helpers. History snapshots are acceptable for ~150KB seed; grouping contiguous typing requires merge metadata/time and caret continuity. Server uses node:sqlite, synchronous transactions and conditional UPDATE WHERE revision=baseRevision, insert history atomically. PUT route body includes id/content/baseRevision and route id mismatch rejected. Static server and APIs. Automated tests can directly exercise HTTP server plus pure editor model exported in browser/global-compatible JS. Build UI accessible controls and revision drawer.
